final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS grp, f.feerate AS rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink WHERE f.orderslink IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT grp, AVG(rate) AS gavg FROM m WHERE rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY grp), ov AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS overall FROM g WHERE gavg IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.grp, g.gavg, ov.overall FROM g CROSS JOIN ov WHERE ov.overall IS NOT NULL AND g.gavg > ov.overall) SELECT AVG(gavg) AS avg_of_kept_group_avgs, AVG(gavg - overall) AS avg_diff_from_overall FROM k
